    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">内容加密，代码可运行：ailatch——AI 时代安全锁</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="103" data-end="130">项目：https://github.com/lo2589/AILatch.git</p>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="103" data-end="130">假设你正在用 Coding Agent 开发一个项目。</p>
<p data-start="132" data-end="153">项目里有两样东西你不希望 AI 随便看到：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-xxxxxx</pre>
</div>

</div>

</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<p data-start="193" data-end="208">以及一段真正有价值的核心代码：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">

<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">

<p data-start="241" data-end="257">但问题是，它们又必须被程序使用。</p>
<p data-start="259" data-end="304">API Key 要在运行时传给服务，核心代码要被 Python import、调用和执行。</p>
<p data-start="306" data-end="320">于是就会出现一个很现实的矛盾：</p>
<blockquote data-start="322" data-end="357">
<p data-start="324" data-end="357"><strong data-start="324" data-end="357">程序需要使用这些信息，但 AI 并不一定需要看到这些信息。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="359" data-end="386">可今天的大多数开发环境里，这两件事往往没有被真正分开。</p>
<p data-start="388" data-end="403">只要内容以明文存在于文件系统，Coding Agent 就可能通过文件遍历、搜索、repository indexing 或主动读取，把它们放进自己的 Context。</p>
<p data-start="512" data-end="524">这在 AI 时代意味着：</p>
<blockquote data-start="322" data-end="357">
<p data-start="324" data-end="357"><strong data-start="324" data-end="357">程序可访问≠<span class="mspace"><span class="mspace"><span class="mrel"><span class="mord vbox"><span class="thinbox"><span class="rlap"><span class="strut"><span class="inner"><span class="mord"><span class="mrel"><span class="fix"><span class="mrel"><span class="mspace"><span class="mspace"><span class="mord text"><span class="mord">AI&nbsp;<span class="mord cjk_fallback">应该可见<span class="pstrut"><span class="stretchy fbox"><span class="vlist-s">​</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="591" data-end="615">&nbsp;<strong data-start="603" data-end="614">AILatch这个项目提供了一种新的思路：</strong></p>
<blockquote>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><span data-start="526" data-end="589" data-math-source="\boxed{
\text{程序可访问}
\;\not\Rightarrow\;
\text{AI 应该可见}
}" data-client-katex-layout=""><span data-start="526" data-end="589" data-math-source="\boxed{
\text{程序可访问}
\;\not\Rightarrow\;
\text{AI 应该可见}
}" data-client-katex-layout=""><span class="strut"><span class="mord"><span class="vlist-t vlist-t2"><span class="vlist-r"><span class="vlist"><span class="pstrut"><span class="boxpad"><span class="mord"><span class="mord"><span class="mord text"><span class="mord cjk_fallback"><span class="mspace"><span class="mspace"><span class="mrel"><span class="mord vbox"><span class="thinbox"><span class="rlap"><span class="strut"><span class="inner"><span class="mord"><span class="mrel"><span class="fix"><span class="mrel"><span class="mspace"><span class="mspace"><span class="mord text"><span class="mord"><span class="mord cjk_fallback"><span class="pstrut"><span class="stretchy fbox"><span class="vlist-s"><span class="vlist-r"><span class="vlist"><span data-start="629" data-end="675" data-math-source="\boxed{
\text{敏感内容保持加密，但授权程序仍然可以使用和执行}
}" data-client-katex-layout=""><span class="strut"><span class="mord"><span class="vlist-t vlist-t2"><span class="vlist-r"><span class="vlist"><span class="pstrut"><span class="boxpad"><span class="mord"><span class="mord"><span class="mord text"><span class="mord cjk_fallback">敏感内容可以保持加密，但授权程序仍然可以使用和执行<span class="pstrut"><span class="stretchy fbox"><span class="vlist-s">​</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</blockquote>
<h2>代码加密了，Python 还能正常运行</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">例如：</p>

<p class="isSelectedEnd">但代码仍然可以运行：</p>

<p class="isSelectedEnd">AILatch 会在 Python 进程内部解密需要的代码，并直接执行。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">整个过程不需要先把明文恢复到工作目录。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">所以真正发生的变化是：</p>
<blockquote>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>代码是否能够执行，不再等于代码是否必须以明文暴露在文件系统里。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<h2>加密模块也可以正常 import</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">假设程序是：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">

<p class="isSelectedEnd">如果&nbsp;<code dir="ltr">secret_module.py</code>&nbsp;已经被 AILatch 加密，它在磁盘上仍然保持密文。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">但在命令行输入：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">

<p class="isSelectedEnd">启动的 runtime 时，AILatch 会处理 encrypted Python module 的加载。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">程序仍然可以：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">

<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">

<div class="cm-scroller">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><code dir="ltr">from secret_module import algorithm</code></pre>
</div>

<p class="isSelectedEnd">正常 import、调用。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">对于应用代码来说，不需要为了 AILatch 改写一套特殊接口。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">这意味着核心模块可以保持：</p>
<blockquote>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>磁盘上：加密</strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>运行时：解密</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<div><span style="font-size: 1.5em; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">不只是代码，数据文件也可以这样使用</span></div>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">AILatch runtime 同时处理：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:python;gutter:true;">open()
Path.read_text()
Path.read_bytes()</pre>
</div>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">例如：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:python;gutter:true;">import json

with open("config.json") as f:
    config = json.load(f)</pre>
</div>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">即使&nbsp;<code dir="ltr">config.json</code>&nbsp;在磁盘上已经被锁定，程序运行时仍然可以读取里面的内容。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">于是 API Key、配置文件、私有数据和核心代码实际上可以采用同一种模型：</p>
<pre><code dir="ltr">AI / grep / indexer
        ↓
    ciphertext

Authorized Runtime
        ↓
   plaintext in memory
        ↓
      use it</code></pre>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">这就是 AILatch 最核心的设计：</p>
<blockquote>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Disk 是密文视图，Runtime 是明文视图。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<h2>开发者自己仍然可以编辑</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">如果代码加密以后只能运行、不能修改，也没什么实际意义。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">所以 AILatch 还提供：</p>
<pre><code dir="ltr">ailatch open &lt;开发目录&gt;</code></pre>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">它会打开一个 plaintext viewport。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">开发者可以查看和编辑被锁定的文件。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">保存时，写回工作目录的仍然是加密内容。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">也就是说，明文可以出现在开发者正在使用的受控视图里，但不需要重新长期落回 repository。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">还可以直接：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:python;gutter:true;">ailatch show secret.py</pre>
</div>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">临时查看一个文件。</p>
<h2>从“文件权限”到“信息可见性”</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">我觉得 Coding Agent 出现以后，一个很重要的变化是：</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">过去我们通常默认：</p>
<pre><code dir="ltr">文件存在
→ 开发工具可以读
→ 程序可以用</code></pre>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">这三件事基本绑在一起。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">但 Agent 会主动搜索、读取、索引整个代码库以后，这种默认关系开始出现问题。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">程序需要使用某段代码，不代表 Agent 一定需要知道它的实现。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">程序需要使用 API Key，不代表模型需要看到 API Key 本身。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">所以可以重新拆成：</p>
<pre><code dir="ltr">Information exists
        ↓
Who can see it?

Information is executable
        ↓
Who can use it?</code></pre>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">这其实是两个不同的问题。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">AILatch 做的事情，就是把它们拆开。</p>
<h2>Information Available ≠ Information Visible</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">从这个角度看，AILatch 不只是一个“Python 文件加密工具”。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">它在尝试建立一种新的信息边界：</p>
<blockquote>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>信息可以存在于系统中，也可以被程序使用，但不需要默认 materialize 给 AI。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">比如：</p>
<pre><code dir="ltr">core_algorithm.py
API keys
private config
internal data</code></pre>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">它们都可以存在。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">程序也可以使用。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">但 Coding Agent 没必要因为能够访问 repository，就自动获得这些信息。</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">所以AI Agent 时代真正需要控制的不只是：</p>
<blockquote>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">谁能访问文件？</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">还包括：</p>
<blockquote>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>什么信息应该对 AI 可见？</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">一句话概括：</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>Keep code encrypted on disk, decrypt it only in memory, and still run it normally.</strong></p>
</blockquote>

</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
